description: This file defines a utility class 'SessionUtil' for managing HTTP session attributes within a web application. It provides static methods to get, set, and remove session attributes.

classes.name: SessionUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to interact with HTTP session attributes.

methods.name: getSessionAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a session attribute by key, cast to a specified type.

methods.name: removeSessionAttribute
methods.description: Removes a session attribute identified by key.

methods.name: setSessionAttribute
methods.description: Sets a session attribute with the provided key and value.
